name: Davanagere Smart City Server Room / Data Centre-CCC
notes: Official smart-city pages describe a server room and network layer connected to the Data Centre/CCC, with city-surveillance feeds sent to the Server Room at the CCC Building. Municipal/ICCC facility rather than commercial colocation or hyperscale capacity.

name: Hubballi-Dharwad Smart City Centralized Data Centre at KMDS / ICCC dedicated data centre
developer: Hubballi-Dharwad Smart City Limited / Karnataka Municipal Data Society
notes: NIUA ICCC listing for Hubballi-Dharwad notes a dedicated data centre / data centre for VMS; Smart Cities completed-project list includes 'MSI - Centralized Data Centre at KMDS' with cost Rs 12.20 crore. Municipal smart-city data centre, not public hyperscale/colo capacity.

name: Tavarekere Data Centre Park near Hoskote-Kolar belt
developer: Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB) / KEONICS
notes: Reported state-backed 300-acre data-centre park at Tavarekere near Hoskote and Kolar; KIADB to acquire 1,000 acres with 250-300 acres allocated to the park. Reported as GW-scale hub-and-spoke; secondary property-market source describes a 500 MW central hub. Division assignment is based on sources placing it on/near the Hoskote-Kolar belt; exact district boundary should be verified from land records.
